desc: Ideation: characterize problem, complexity target, and candidate approaches (monotonic-stack contribution, Cartesian tree, right-endpoint deque sweep, divide & conquer, offline union-find).
Implement `sum_of_mins(nums, k)` via monotonic-stack canonical-min boundaries with the capped two-sided pair-count formula.
Implement the capped pair-count helper via inclusion-exclusion with G(t)=(t+1)(t+2)//2.
Obtain max-subarray sum by reusing `sum_of_mins` on negated values; combine into `Solution.minMaxSubarraySum`.
Verify against Examples 1 and 2 and brute-force random small arrays (varying k, negatives, duplicates) plus edge cases (k=1, all-equal, all-negative, n=1, k=n); report the SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
